amendment_reason: Adds categorical band-selection stability and band-attributed margins after an external mechanism probe showed that a summary layer hid low-to-middle band failover. No gate or threshold changes.
object: cross-context high-occupancy eigenspaces of mean projectors for frozen low-frequency bands of normalized reliability-weighted sheaf Laplacians
selection_rule: choose the lowest-frequency band meeting the geometry gate in frozen band order; outcome-based band selection is prohibited

geometry_gate.occupancy_margin: minimum_occupancy minus 0.75; margins below 0.10 emit a fixture-calibrated warning but do not change the gate

selection_stability.reference: selected band at the registered reference run; positive-noise sweeps use the smallest strictly positive level
selection_stability.warning_rule: selected_band != reference_selected_band emits a mandatory warning and makes lineage serialization mandatory
selection_stability.claim_effect: failover remains engineering evidence pending lineage review; no geometry, policy, or edit threshold changes

band_attribution.rule: rank, minimum occupancy, occupancy margin, and margin warning are emitted with a band name for every band and for the selected band

direct_edit_gate.application: prohibited_in_discovery_stage; emit normalized proposal and hash only

standing_controls.dense_occupancy_calibration: selected_band is a required grouping key and failover warning source
standing_controls.occupancy_matched_low_lineage: common orthogonal conjugation holds the complete occupancy spectrum and selected band fixed while rotating identity; unit construction validation required before capped scale-up
standing_controls.sparse_geometry_noise: zero remains a legacy RNG compatibility point; positive sweeps use the smallest positive reference

receipt_requirements.external_replays: must record source archive SHA-256 and remain diagnostic-only
receipt_requirements.selection_summary: must never report rank or occupancy without selected_band

claim_boundary: A pass identifies a stable spectral bundle useful for grouped prediction and bounded candidate allocation. Selection stability distinguishes band failover from within-band lineage loss. Neither establishes real-model self-improvement, compactification, or RSI.
